definition: SHELL(C)=dual-graph distance from STAR(O_E) to C

exact_combinatorial_certificate.typing: K and H are auxiliary A2 incidence-label certificates for graph distance, not source Euclidean coordinates or a target length metric

shell_theorems.edge_lipschitz: adjacent cells differ in shell by at most 1
shell_theorems.outward_branch_count: every even-shell cell has exactly one shell-(s+1) neighbor; every odd-shell cell has exactly two

farthest_rule.global_relation: FAR(C)=FAR_PLUS(C)={D in N3(C): SHELL(D)=SHELL(C)+1} for every cell C
farthest_rule.tie_handling: all outward maximizers survive; no tie breaker

translation_semantics: shell is centered at the fixed signed origin-star; a translated problem must translate both the distinguished star and cell carrier before recomputing graph distance
